gloss: return trip; return route; way back

definitions.gloss: return trip; return route; way back
definitions.explanation: The journey or route back to the starting point. The second half of a round trip.

examples.japanese: {復路|ふくろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I took the train for the return trip.

examples.japanese: {復路|ふくろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: The return trip took a long time because of traffic.

examples.japanese: ⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{復路|ふくろ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{順位|じゅんい}→順位：14679_juni⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げた→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧がいた。
examples.english: There was a runner who moved up in the rankings on the return leg of the marathon.

notes:
Composed of {復|ふく} (return, repeat) and {路|ろ} (road, route). A somewhat formal word, commonly seen in transportation schedules and race descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {復路|ふくろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{便|びん}→便：28160_bin⟧: return flight/service
- ⟦{往復|おうふく}→往復：04111_oufuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{復路|ふくろ}: return leg of a round trip
- {復路|ふくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: to run the return course

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{往路|おうろ}→往路：18214_ouro⟧: outbound trip, outward route — the first half of the journey

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{往復|おうふく}→往復：04111_oufuku⟧: round trip — encompasses both directions
- ⟦{帰路|きろ}→帰路：16079_kiro⟧: way home — similar meaning but specifically means going home
- ⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰り：01275_kaeri⟧: the return, the way back — more colloquial
